//: Tasks moved to a Codex implementation. Since 2026-10-06 (ops/approvals.yaml id 23; 规划/11 §1.1 例外「改由 Codex 实现的任务」, §2.5, §7.3 row 14) the exception is granted per split task, not per 规划/05 row: an entry with a lowercase suffix (B1-14a) lets that one task through; an entry without one (B3-02) is a row the exception covers whole, with all its split tasks. Rows only partly in the exception (B1-14, QA-05, QA-09; B3-07 without its A/B/C judgement) are listed task by task. Since 2026-10-16 (ops/approvals.yaml id 30; 规划/11 §1.1「2026-10-16 起：未开工的任务默认由 Codex 实现」, §7.3 row 15; planning couli#114 and #115) a task not yet started defaults to a Codex implementation: started means rule tests or an implementation committed (a spec_commit, a test(spec) commit or an implementation commit; a claim or a brief alone does not count), and started tasks keep their split. Each such task is added to tasks one by one under the id of its ledger, never as a whole row (a row would also let through its split tasks already started); the approval field stays 23 for the rows of 2026-10-06, and an entry outside those rows rests on id 30. A listed ledger may name impl: codex with tester: claude: a Claude subagent writes the rule tests first (red), a fresh Codex read-only session reviews them, Codex implements through codex-run.sh impl --phase impl, and a fresh Claude subagent reviews the code (id 27: the family other than the implementer). Funds, attribution, payout, order back-fill, database recovery and failover, release-pipeline wiring, migrations and contracts stay with id 19 whatever the date: forbidden_paths below are unchanged and task.ts check refuses a listed ledger whose paths reach them. The native apps also move their new tasks to Codex under id 30, but those repositories are not gated by this list (the orchestrator runs their builds and simulator checks outside the sandbox). Since the evening of 2026-10-16 (ops/approvals.yaml id 33; 规划/11 §1.1「2026-10-16 晚负责人再放开 H5 与管理后台前端」, §7.3 row 15 note; planning couli#118) new tasks of the H5 and admin frontends (apps/h5/**, apps/admin/**) also default to a Codex implementation, so those two globs left forbidden_paths; started tasks keep their split, and a task whose design is not final is not dispatched. Since 2026-10-17 (ops/approvals.yaml id 34; 规划/11 §1.1「2026-10-17 起：实现回到 Claude，Codex 只做对抗评审」, §7.3 row 16; owner: implementation returns to Claude, Codex reviews only) the list is FROZEN: id 30 is superseded, no task is added any more (tools/lib/codex-impl-tasks.test.ts holds the frozen set and fails on any entry outside it; removals are fine), tasks listed and already started finish as a Codex implementation under ids 31 and 33, and a listed task not yet started goes back to impl: claude, tester: codex at its next ledger PR and leaves the list. A new ledger outside the list names impl: claude (task.ts check). apps/h5/** and apps/admin/** stay out of forbidden_paths so the started frontend ledgers still pass; the freeze alone stops new ones. Read from the trusted root. Protected path, class 3: a change needs the owner approval label (owner-approved-<first 12 hex of the head>), which the orchestrator adds after checking the head commit (ops/approvals.yaml id 24).
//forbidden_paths: A listed ledger whose paths may reach any of these (funds, attribution, payout, orders, migrations, contracts, clients, gates; a superset of MONEY_PATHS in tools/ci/evidence-check.ts) is refused by task.ts check whatever its suffix: those parts stay with id 19 (Claude review S2-1, Codex review GT-23a round 2, 2026-10-06). Only type impl is let through.
//mechanical_paths: Since 2026-10-16 (ops/approvals.yaml id 31, decided by the orchestrator under 规划/11 §7.3 row 11 to carry out id 30; rebate-platform #522): an interface task implemented by Codex must leave planned in the same pull request, so a listed ledger may name some of these in its own mechanical_paths (never in paths: forbidden_paths still refuse contracts/** and packages/contracts-ts/**). Codex never writes them. Only a Claude commit carrying the trailer `Couli-Mechanical: contract-codegen` may change them, and such a commit may change nothing else; guard-git (tools/guard/lib/mechanical.ts) checks that the contract file only loses `x-implementation: planned` lines and that a *.gen.ts file is only modified; that the generated files equal a fresh `pnpm contracts:codegen` is checked by the required checks contracts-gate (codegen --check) and ci-gate (contract-routes.test.ts). Every other commit of the task branch is still held to the ledger paths.
